articles.title: Five-Minute Museum Heist: Renoir Paintings Swiped in France
articles.summary: In a daring five-minute heist, thieves used an electric saw to steal two Renoir paintings from a French museum. They dropped two others while fleeing police. The artworks are worth millions—and the hunt is on!

articles.title: Before 'America': The Wild Name Ideas the Founders Rejected
articles.summary: The United States almost had a very different name—like Alleghania or the United Colonies. Discover why the founders chose 'United States' and why the 'U' in 'United' was originally lowercase.

articles.title: Elton John Dusts Off Rare 1969 Gem 'Skyline Pigeon' at Rock in Rio
articles.summary: At Rock in Rio, Elton John performed 'Skyline Pigeon' for the first time since 2019—a song he called the first good one he wrote with Bernie Taupin. It's a hit in Brazil, and he explained why!
